title: DuckDB C++ API not working with SQL statements
body:
### What happens?

I try to run the C++ code, which is more-less taken from the DuckDB documentation, but I can't make it work. Compilation is fine, but the output from Print() function is an error message:

    Parser Error: syntax error at or near "..."

The "..." represent some random characters, each time I run it, it is something different. I am using

    Windows 11
    Visual Studio 2022
    C++20
    compiler flag /utf-8.

I used a DuckDB library downloaded from DuckDB web site. Also, I compiled the library with VS from the source. I am getting the mentioned error with both libraries.

### To Reproduce

int main()
{
   duckdb::DuckDB db(nullptr);
   duckdb::Connection con(db);

   std::string qs0{ "CREATE TABLE mytbl(a INTEGER, b INTEGER)" };
   con.Query(qs0);

   std::string qs1{ "INSERT INTO mytbl(a, b) VALUES (3, 4)" };
   con.Query(qs1);

   con.Query("SELECT * FROM mytbl")->Print();
}

### OS:

Windows 11

### DuckDB Version:

Latest from master branch (11/8/2023)

### DuckDB Client:

C++

### Full Name:

Lubomir Kordos

### Affiliation:

Lukosoft Canada

### Have you tried this on the latest `master` branch?

I have tested with a master build

### Have you tried the steps to reproduce? Do they include all relevant data and configuration? Does the issue you report still appear there?

- [X] Yes, I have

participant1
comments.body: HasError returns true when the SQL query you tried to run fails. As I mentioned on the stack overflow post, that happens when the SQL you're trying to run is invalid, or some other error occurs. You'll need to check the error that's returned to determine what went wrong

However, as I said, the example from documentation (with hardcoded SQL strings in the query) is not functional in my environment.

comments.body:
Here are my further observations on Windows 11, MS VC 2022:

I modified the C code posted above, to use the parquet file instead of in memory DB.
I tried two scenarios:

1/ I used the duckdb library downloaded from https://duckdb.org/docs/installation/index:
the C API code is working, however the duckdb_open doesn't accept the full path to the parquet file, i.e. C:/dir/dir/file_name.parquet. To make it work I had to put the parquet file to current directory and use only the file name without the path.

C++ API is not working.

2/ I built the DLL library from the source on GitHub with MS VS 2022 CMake project

C API is not working:
during the runtime I get exception:
file:            duckdb-c.cpp
function:    duckdb_state duckdb_connect(duckdb_database database, duckdb_connection *out), line 49
statement: connection = new Connection(*wrapper->database);

C++ API not working

The build with VS CMake project finished without errors. However, there were 7 warnings of following two (I'm not sure what impact, if any, they have):

1/ unexpected tokens following preprocessor directive - expected a new line. File: generated_extension_loader.hpp line 11
2/ '>>': right shift by too large amount, data loss. File: output_bit_stream.hpp line 85, 91

Hopefully this could help in investigation.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
The exception is: Exception thrown: read access violation. _Other was 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF7.
The reason: the DB is not open, consequently the connection throws.

The DB problem is in: MainHeader MainHeader::Deserialize(Deserializer &source), line 56

if (header.version_number != VERSION_NUMBER) -> debug values are -> 51 != 55,  the 'version_text is "DuckDB version v0.8.0 or v0.8.1"
This code throws, but it is silently swallowed .

comments.body:
So, I get new parquet data files (the dataset is too big so I have set of partial parquet chunk files). I tried C and it works.

The C++ works if I am using duckdb::DuckDB db(nullptr);
If I try to pass as argument the full-path-name for the chunk file, or */*.parquet to build the DB, the APi throws.

I could not find any example where the C++ DuckDB constructor takes a file name as argument. All examples use NULL. Could you point me to some source with info, please?

Also, is there any API to get the DB version to avoid this type of problems? Thanks.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
DuckDB does not support opening a parquet file as a database, only loading the data once a database has been opened (either in memory, using the null argument, or on disk)

Does this mean you've now resolved your encoding issue?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: yes, thanks.

comments.body: I also got this parsing error on Windows. It seems the error occurs only in debug mode. After switching to release everything works. So it might be related to the corrupted std::string when library is compiled in "Release" mode and you are trying to run the application in "Debug" mode.
